title: Scenario
description: One randomized simulated world plus the result of running the pushed control code inside it. One cell of the ScenarioMatrix grid.

seed.description: RNG seed. Replaying this seed reproduces the world exactly — this is what makes failures reproducible for the Investigator.

label.description: Short human name, e.g. 'heavy cube, low friction'.

params.description: The sampled world parameters. Keys come from robotci.yaml `scenarios.randomize`; values are concrete scalars.

attempt.description: 1 for the baseline suite, incremented on VERIFY re-runs.

detail.description: Scorer note, e.g. why nothing was checked.

diagnosis.description: Human-readable failure explanation from simkit/scoring.py, e.g. 'Gripper closed 40mm before reaching the cube; object never left the table.' This string is the primary input to the Investigator agent — it is the oracle's voice, not an agent's guess.

video_path.description: Path under ARTIFACTS_DIR to the recorded mp4.

live_frame_path.description: Path under ARTIFACTS_DIR to the most recent rendered frame while status='running'. Overwritten in place by the worker; the API serves it as a live MJPEG stream. Null once the scenario finishes and video_path takes over.

worker_id.description: Which suite worker is simulating this scenario. Lets the dashboard group live tiles by worker and show the pool saturated.

progress.description: Fraction of the scenario's simulated horizon completed. Advisory only — never a success signal.

trace_path.description: Path to the joint/state trace for offline analysis.

error.description: Set for status='error': the sim itself broke, distinct from the robot failing the task.

error_kind.description: Why an error occurred; timeout is distinct from other infrastructure errors.

retries.description: Number of infrastructure retries before the final attempt.

retry_reason.description: Reason the scenario was retried, when applicable.
